notes_for_editor: Thin record. Only the Canada Lookouts listing (district label, position, elevation) and the federal name entry for Old Fort Mountain were found, from 2 searches and a few page reads. No source on build date, builder, staffing, fires, fate or present condition was found, so the story is short on purpose; it is below the usual 120 words because missing topics are left out. The federal peak sits about 0.6 km north-northwest of the listed Canada Lookouts position (distance and bearing computed from the two cited coordinates; an earlier 0.1 km figure was wrong), but no source says the lookout stands on that peak. The N and W hemispheres in the story are inferred from the unsigned listing (Lat. 55.083 Lon. 126.383), which is correct for BC. Worth a history search (Forest History Association of BC, BC Forest Service reports, firelookout.ca record) before publishing as more than a stub.
